lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Real ~24 deg fold between the straight strip (patches 1/2, y 15-25) and the angled end leg (patches 13/6). Line is on the outer, convex (-x) skin apex: in the XY sections at 25/50/75% the nearest points are 0.04, 0.19 and 0.20 mm away and the line sits on the corner where the two outer-skin plane fits meet. It is parallel to the fold (direction is about +z). The line runs z -75.7 to -8.7 (67.0 mm); the fold where both plates exist runs about -76.4 to -7.5 (about 69 mm), so the line covers about 97%. The leg tab that carries a hole and reaches further to about z -80.8 has no strip beneath it, so no fold runs there.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Real kink of about 21 deg (about 27 deg against the arc tangent) where the R~30 rolled arc meets the straight strip at y~15. The outer (+x) skin shows a distinct corner and the inner skin is rounded. The line is on the outer apex: nearest points are 0.16, 0.06 and 0.53 mm away at 25/50/75%, and the 0.53 mm comes from a gap in point density at the apex, while the line still sits on the plane intersection. It is parallel to the fold. The line covers z -75.0 to -8.5 (66.5 mm) of a fold that runs about -76.45 to -7.5 (69 mm), about 96%.
